description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the number of tokens and the number of tokens for different categories: Tutorials, Library Documentation, Github files, and StackOverflow posts. The x-axis, labeled "Number of Tokens," is on a linear scale ranging from 10 to 800. The y-axis, labeled "Number of Tokens," also uses a linear scale ranging from 10 to 40. The line representing Tutorials, marked with blue circles and a solid line, starts at approximately 20 tokens and increases to about 40 tokens. The line for Library Documentation, marked with red circles and a solid line, begins at around 30 tokens and rises to approximately 40 tokens. The line for Github files, marked with green circles and a solid line, starts at about 30 tokens and increases to around 40 tokens. Lastly, the line for StackOverflow posts, marked with yellow circles and a solid line, begins at approximately 30 tokens and decreases to about 20 tokens.
